name: Drawer
description: A side panel for secondary navigation or contextual actions.

accessibility.semantics: Use native semantic elements before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Interactive descendants must be reachable by keyboard and expose visible focus.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion where animation exists.

responsive.strategy: Intrinsic layout with logical properties, responsive grids, and container queries where useful.

examples.name: Default
examples.notes: Use semantic landmarks and tokenized styling.

behavior.keyboard: Escape closes the drawer; Tab and Shift+Tab remain within the panel.
behavior.dismissal: The explicit close button and optional scrim close the drawer and restore focus.
